description: This source file implements the GroupingTypesWritePlatformService using JPA repository pattern for managing groups, centers, and related entities within the Fineract project. It contains methods for creating, updating, activating, closing, and associating/disassociating clients and groups with centers, including validation and integrity checks.

classes.name: GroupingTypesWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of group management service handling creation, update, activation, closure, and association/disassociation of groups and centers within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createGroupingType
methods.description: Core logic for creating a new group or center, including validation, account number generation, and hierarchy setup.

methods.name: generateAccountNumber
methods.description: Generates and assigns an account number to a new group/center based on its type.

methods.name: createCenter
methods.description: Transactional method to create a new center, triggers event notification after creation.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Transactional method to create a new group under a specified center, triggers event notification after creation.

methods.name: activateGroupOrCenter
methods.description: Activates a group or center, validating dates and rules.

methods.name: validateGroupRulesBeforeActivation
methods.description: Checks whether the group meets the criteria for activation, such as client count.

methods.name: updateCenter
methods.description: Updates details of an existing center.

methods.name: updateGroup
methods.description: Updates details of an existing group.

methods.name: updateGroupingType
methods.description: Internal method for updating group or center information and hierarchy.

methods.name: unassignGroupOrCenterStaff
methods.description: Removes assigned staff from a group or center.

methods.name: assignGroupOrCenterStaff
methods.description: Assigns staff to a group or center, optionally updating related loans and savings accounts.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a group if it is in a pending state, also deletes related notes.

methods.name: closeGroup
methods.description: Closes a group after validating loans and savings accounts.

methods.name: validateLoansAndSavingsForGroupOrCenterClose
methods.description: Checks whether loans and savings accounts are in a state that allows closing the group or center.

methods.name: closeCenter
methods.description: Closes a center after validating no active groups are associated with it.

methods.name: assembleSetOfClients
methods.description: Creates a set of client entities based on provided client IDs, validating office association.

methods.name: assembleSetOfChildGroups
methods.description: Creates a set of child group entities based on provided group IDs, validating office association.

methods.name: handleGroupDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity errors, particularly duplicate external IDs or names.

methods.name: associateClientsToGroup
methods.description: Associates existing clients to a group after validation.

methods.name: disassociateClientsFromGroup
methods.description: Removes clients from a group, ensuring no active loans or savings are linked.

methods.name: associateGroupsToCenter
methods.description: Associates child groups with a center, validating meeting recurrence consistency.

methods.name: disassociateGroupsToCenter
methods.description: Removes child groups from a center.

methods.name: checkForActiveJLGLoans
methods.description: Checks if clients have active loans preventing disassociation.

methods.name: validateForJLGSavings
methods.description: Checks if clients have active savings accounts preventing disassociation.

methods.name: validateOfficeOpeningDateisAfterGroupOrCenterOpeningDate
methods.description: Ensures activation date is not before parent office creation date.

methods.name: checkGroupMembersMeetingSyncWithCenterMeeting
methods.description: Validates that group meeting schedules are consistent with the center.
